Get ready for an unforgettable experience as FYI Yachts proudly joins the 2025 Palm Beach International Boat Show, taking place from March 19-23 along Flagler Drive in downtown West Palm Beach. This premier event, situated across the Intracoastal Waterway from Palm Beach Island, showcases some of the most exquisite yachts in the world and is a must-attend for boating enthusiasts and industry professionals alike.

Since its inception in 1982, the Palm Beach International Boat Show has become a key player in South Florida’s marine industry, contributing significantly to the region’s economy. A 2022 economic impact analysis revealed that the show generates over $1.05 billion in statewide economic activity. With more than 55,000 visitors attending in previous years, the show has resulted in over $725 million in total sales. This year, attendees can expect an even grander showcase, featuring more than $1.2 billion worth of yachts and accessories, with boats ranging from compact 8-foot inflatables to breathtaking superyachts nearly 300 feet in length.

FYI Yachts is thrilled to present the remarkable 57 OKEAN and 52 OKEAN 2025 models at Ramp 2. The Palm Beach International Boat Show has established itself as a crucial spring launch point for both U.S. and European yacht builders, offering an ideal platform for introducing new models to the American market. This year’s show will see an even higher number of new boat unveilings than The Miami International Boat Show, making it a prime destination for serious buyers and industry insiders.

What sets PBIBS apart is its balance of elegance and accessibility. While the event continues to expand, it maintains an inviting atmosphere with wider docks and a more relaxed setting compared to other major shows. This allows guests to explore the latest yacht innovations at their own pace while receiving top-tier personalized service.
